baseline_reuse: one all-replan game per deal and starting player, reused across four focal-seat pairs
overlap_rule: abort before games if test hand partitions repeat development or another test case; compare ignoring seat permutation and within-hand order
aggregation: equal focal seats within start, equal starts within deal, equal deals
outer_unit: fresh initial deal on the same fixed synthetic map
paired_unit: deal x starting player x focal seat
tie_rule: 1/k victory share after score and completed-ticket tiebreak
inference: exploratory fresh-deal test pilot; no confidence interval, significance, or confirmatory claim
post_view_rule: these four test deals are consumed after viewing; later tuning must use a newly frozen test cohort
